findings.finding: The complete domestic row has eight stages. Its first added unit contains the upper horizontal and right descending hook; its second added unit is the upper left-falling stroke.

The foreign source begins with the upper left-falling stroke. Its second upper fold reaches toward the right then descends left toward the enclosure. This trajectory and upper outline differ from the domestic right-descending hook.
Both sources label the character 兔, yet their upper subforms differ. Equal code points and equal total counts do not authorize merging the forms or replacing the domestic order.

Domestic steps 3–8 and foreign strokes 3–8 add the same broad enclosure, sweep, bent-hook and dot units in the same ordinal positions. Direct domestic start/end/turn trajectories are still absent from the static row.
The fresh pinned Ko corpus contains no 兔. Ja and MM each supply eight preserved original medians, both following the foreign-style upper order and shape.
Actual width-5 generated candidates and their hypothetical [2,1,3,4,5,6,7,8] order-only swap were visually inspected. Reordering does not create the domestic upper right-descending hook.

nextRequiredEvidence: A Korean source that explicitly establishes the requested domestic upper shape's path and within-stroke direction, or a documented decision resolving the two upper forms, before authoring a correction or considering playback approval.
